qualification: Development on four dates; policy coefficients frozen before two separate validation dates. Afterwards, integer-price rounding/boundary repairs changed some marks; no outcome-based coefficient tuning after validation. Final results include those precision repairs. This is not fully untouched final-code holdout qualification.

method.entry: Execution-second close after confirmation plus 2-second live publication buffer
method.risk: Distance from entry to observed extreme plus the detector's observation-time band width; baseline fixed $5 band, adaptive variable band
method.outcome: 1R target before 1R stop within 5 minutes; same-second ambiguity and timeouts fail
method.control: One 20-minute shifted-time control with identical dollar risk and side; descriptive only
method.cost_scenarios: Add 2 or 5 bps of entry price to target hurdle; stop unchanged. Hypothetical sensitivity scenarios, not exchange fee schedules or net PnL. Spread, slippage and fills are not modeled.
method.warmup: Full UTC input days, assessed sessions start after >=5 minutes; no future inputs in detector
method.bounds: Each CSV <=128 MiB, <=2M executions, <=90k seconds; stream one input at a time, no retained raw vector

limitations: Selected six-day event study, not a portfolio backtest or proof of profitability
Whole-day results and quiet-weekend results did not improve overall
Risk widths differ by policy; gross success rates alone are not an equal-risk profit comparison
No daily signal quota; a quiet session can have fewer than 5 marks
Adaptive internal coefficients remain fixed policy constants; users have visibility switches only
Minimum exchange tick precision remains the physical resolution floor

semantic_regressions: Legacy knobs and visibility do not affect computed evidence
Resumed original aggression blocks exhaustion confirmation
Future conditions do not resize old evidence
Compaction conserves buy/sell notional within 16-band cap

assessment_priority: Active-session usefulness and frequency, per user clarification. Quieter periods remain disclosed separately; weaker quiet-session performance alone is not treated as a logic defect. The detector has no time-of-day gate. Execution count is an activity proxy, not measured L2 liquidity.
